sets.name: 01-editorial
sets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-resolution webpage design template SET for "Role Lens", an app comparing CV evidence against position-specific classification rubrics. A single landscape presentation board containing THREE complete desktop webpage mockups, arranged clearly with generous spacing, consistent design system across all three, crisp legible typography and realistic interface content. Screens: 1 Positions dashboard with search, Add positions, saved role cards and candidate counts; 2 Senior Product Designer role showing Add candidate CVs, Compare classifications table with 4 fictional candidates and weighted evidence coverage, navigation Role & rubric and Export results; 3 candidate evidence detail with rubric criteria, verified source quote, gaps and interview prompts. Include small note "Evidence coverage, not hiring probability". Use fictional sample data. This is a flat UI design artifact, no devices, no perspective, no photography, no decorative 3D. Each screen should have enough width to clearly show its page structure. Design direction: refined light editorial workspace. Ivory-white backgrounds, ink typography, fine gray dividers, restrained cobalt accents, elegant large headings, precise whitespace, compact top navigation. Dashboard uses a refined role card grid; comparison page uses an exceptionally clear table; evidence view uses two columns with document excerpt and rubric. Premium understated professional software.
